jobs.title: LLM Applications Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Lumen Legal builds contract-review tools used by law firms in the DACH region.

What you'll do

  • Work closely with product and engineering to ship improvements every week.
  • Own your work from design document to production.

Requirements

  • Python.
  • LLM application development.
  • RAG pipelines.
  • LangChain.

Nice to have

  • Evaluation of LLM outputs.

Compensation

€70,000 - €80,000 per year
